# Craftmypdf

CraftMyPDF is a web-based platform that enables users to design and generate customizable PDF documents using pre-designed templates and dynamic data.

Category: Productivity. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/craftmypdf/.

## Actions

- **Create PDF Asynchronously**: Queue asynchronous PDF generation via webhook.
- **List PDF Templates** (read-only): Retrieve a paginated list of PDF templates.
- **Create Editor Session**: Create an embeddable editor session URL for a template.
